test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Major Rock Edicts of Ashoka states that Dhammayatras (tours) would be undertaken by the emperor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Major Rock Edict VIII.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Major Rock Edict VIII**- Ashoka’s first visit to Bodh Gaya and the Bodhi tree (his first Dhamma Yatra).
 
• **Gave importance to Dhamma tours. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Rock Edict I**
